title: Board Fixture Node Caption From Kind Catalog
description: Board play Nakagin capsule nodes show no caption because fixtureNodeDisplayText drops cs_* labels. Resolve overlay text from meta.kindCatalogs.nodes by nodeKind when primary caption is absent.
summary: Node captions now use kit piece names from fixture `label` (e.g. `cs_sl1_d0_t_f4_b_c1`), not kind-catalog type labels like `J`. Removed `cs_*` suppression and the `meta.kindCatalogs.nodes` fallback added earlier. `parseBoardFixtureV1` maps `text` ← explicit `text` or trimmed `label`. Vitest updated and passing for fixture io.
